detail: Yes, but citation work should follow inclusion and top-3 recovery on competitor-heavy prompts.
Mention 24%, non-branded mention 5%, top-3 16%, citation 0%, competitor-only 73%.
Search-connected AI, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini with search, voice assistants, and shopping experiences rely more heavily on source trust.
A cited strategy cannot fix answers that never mention iBOLT. The first lift is getting iBOLT included and recommended.
Source-ready pages: quick answers, exact product names, comparison blocks, FAQ schema, Article/Product schema, internal links, and retesting.
External corroboration: third-party guides, comparison placements, backlinks, partner pages, and category mentions beside competitor defaults.
